title: Ergothioneine’s scientific evidence, marketing spark debate in China
abstract: “Customers that consume ergothioneine have only demonstrated that they are easily fooled,” said Prof Rao, Dean of Sciences at Peking University (PKU). A day later on June 6, the company responded to Prof Rao’s article, where it defended ergothioneine by citing a series of clinical trials findings. *NutraIngredients-Asia* spoke with a company specialising in ergothioneine production to find out more about its views on the ongoing debate in China. In this regard, the company, while advancing science and commercialisation of ergothioneine with the long-term vision that it is good for healthy ageing, it is also selective of the brands that it partners with. Dr May-Zhang said that Blue California had conducted a clinical trial on ergothioneine and cognitive function, with findings submitted for peer review. Blue California is said to be the first company to receive US FDA-reviewed Generally Recognised as Safe (GRAS) status for its ErgoActive ergothioneine back in 2019.
